blurb: Explore the wonderful wines of Niagara-on-the-Lake, Ontario, Canada on this small group, intimate, 5.5-hour tour to three separate wineries. Enjoy tastings of three or four wines at each stop and a delicious Picnic style lunch after your 1st stop. Emerse your self in Niagara's Wine culture, learn about the winemaking process and the wines themselves, while trying and discovering each wine’s unique tasting notes. Tastings will include Red, White and Niagara's famous Ice Wine. Pick up and drop off from your Niagara On The Lake or Niagara Falls Accommodations is included. This fully guided, comprehensive wine tour will not disappoint! Please note wineries are subject to change without notice, and is based on winery availability.
